map.实心圆轴扭转剪应力（本页代码口径，直径按 m 输入）：极惯性矩 J=π×d⁴÷3: Torsional shear stress in a solid circular shaft (per this page's code, diameter entered in m): polar moment J = π×d⁴÷32 (m⁴); τ = torque T×(d÷2)÷J (Pa); linked values: MPa value = τ÷10⁶ (MPa, main result), torsional section modulus W_t = π×d³÷16, recomputed W_t = J×2÷d. Validation: both fields are required by the input guard and must be valid numbers, otherwise prompt and abort. Criteria: no fixed grading; τ is proportional to torque and inversely proportional to the cube of diameter, so doubling the diameter cuts stress to one eighth.
